phone.changelog: v3.9.19: 2-3x faster startup. Deep catalog 30→15 pages, timeouts 8s→3s. Same perf fixes as TV v3.17.23.

tv.changelog: v3.17.24: UX + player controls. Exit-confirm dialog (no accidental exits), per-server failure reasons on dead screen, media-key support (Play/Pause/Seek/Stop), double-tap seek (±30s), backdrop-blur removed (30-40% GPU relief on low-end TVs), poster shimmer placeholders, image async decoding. Includes v3.17.23 speed fixes.
